import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from build import CASES, LAW, POLICIES, ZONE


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def check(bundle):
    bundle = Path(bundle)

    source = json.loads((bundle/'assignment-source.json').read_text())
    plan = json.loads((bundle/'case-plan.json').read_text())
    suffix = cfg['case_id'].split('__')[-2]+'__'+cfg['case_id'].split('__')[-1]
    candidate = cfg['candidate_id']
    if (suffix not in CASES or candidate not in POLICIES or
            cfg['case_id'] != cfg['assignment_id']+'__'+suffix or
            source['law']['text'] != LAW or
            plan['source_law']['text'] != LAW):
        raise ValueError('exact law/case source')
    if (cfg['assignment_sha256'] != sha(bundle/'assignment-source.json') or
            cfg['case_plan_sha256'] != sha(bundle/'case-plan.json') or
            cfg['road_sha256'] != sha(bundle/'alley-zone.xodr') or
            cfg['tracks_sha256'] != sha(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')):
        raise ValueError('copied source hashes')
    root = ET.parse(bundle/'alley-zone.xodr').getroot()
    roads = root.findall('./road')
    sections=roads[0].findall('./lanes/laneSection') if len(roads)==1 else []
    topology=[(section.get('s'),[(lane.get('id'),lane.get('type'))
               for lane in section.findall('./right/lane')]) for section in sections]
    if len(roads) != 1 or roads[0].get('id') != '374' or topology != [
        ('0',[('-1','driving'),('-2','driving')]),
        ('40',[('-1','sidewalk'),('-2','driving')]),
        ('60',[('-1','driving'),('-2','driving')])]:
        raise ValueError('alley lane topology')
    speed,camera,stop = POLICIES[candidate]
    through = suffix == CASES[0]
    if (cfg['requested_zone_route'] is not through or
            cfg['requested_ego_speed_mps'] != speed or cfg['camera_policy'] != camera or
            cfg['stop_x_m'] != stop or cfg['zone_rectangle_xy_m'] != list(ZONE) or
            cfg['physical_zone_designation_verified'] is not False or
            cfg['actual_zone_overlap_observed'] is not False):
        raise ValueError('candidate policy or unverified zone status')
    tracks = rows(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')
    if len(tracks) != 600:
        raise ValueError('600-frame request')
    encounter = 0
    for i,row in enumerate(tracks):
        t=(i+1)/20
        x=round(min(stop if stop is not None else 150,5+speed*t),6)
        y=-1.75 if through else -5.25
        if (row['frame'] != i or row['time_s'] != t or
                row['requested_ego_x_m'] != x or row['requested_ego_y_m'] != y or
                row['requested_lane_id'] != (-1 if through else -2) or
                row['requested_zone_route'] is not through or
                row['physical_zone_designation_verified'] is not False or
                row['actual_zone_overlap_observed'] is not False):
            raise ValueError('request row differs')
        encounter += int(ZONE[0] <= x <= ZONE[1])
    if candidate == 'fallback3' and encounter != 0 or \
       candidate != 'fallback3' and encounter == 0:
        raise ValueError('pass/stop request geometry')
    return {'case_id':cfg['case_id'],'candidate_id':candidate,
            'requested_zone_route':through,'requested_encounter_frames':encounter,
            'actual_zone_overlap_observed':False,'delivery_ready':False}

        require(len(streams)==1 and streams[0].get('codec_name')=='ffv1' and
                streams[0].get('nb_read_frames')=='600','original FFV1 frames')

def validate_vehicle(ego,actor_id):
    require(type(ego) is dict and ego.get('actor_id')==actor_id and
            ego.get('blueprint')=='vehicle.tesla.model3','ego identity')
    center=ego.get('center_native_xyz_m');velocity=ego.get('velocity_native_xyz_mps')
    body=ego.get('body_native_xyz_m')

            type(velocity) is list and len(velocity)==3 and all(map(finite,velocity)) and
            finite(ego.get('speed_mps')) and ego['speed_mps']>=0 and
            abs(math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in velocity))-ego['speed_mps'])<.01 and
            type(body) is list and len(body)==8 and
            all(type(p) is list and len(p)==3 and all(map(finite,p)) for p in body),
            'finite ego pose/body/speed')
    xs=[p[0] for p in body];ys=[p[1] for p in body]
    require(3<=max(xs)-min(xs)<=7 and 1.3<=max(ys)-min(ys)<=7 and
            abs((max(xs)+min(xs))/2-center[0])<1 and
            abs((max(ys)+min(ys))/2-center[1])<1,

import json

from build import put,put_rows,sha


def vehicle(x,y,v):
    corners=((x-2,y-.9),(x-2,y+.9),(x+2,y+.9),(x+2,y-.9))
    return {'actor_id':101,'blueprint':'vehicle.tesla.model3',
        'center_native_xyz_m':[x,y,1.5],
        'velocity_native_xyz_mps':[v,0,0], 'speed_mps':v,
        'body_native_xyz_m':[[round(px,6),round(py,6),z]
                              for z in (.5,2.5) for px,py in corners]}


def build(bundle,output):
    bundle,output=map(Path,(bundle,output))
    if output.exists():raise ValueError('raw output must be fresh')
    cfg=json.loads((bundle/'config.json').read_text())
    requests=[json.loads(line) for line in (bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    markers=[{'actor_id':200+i,'blueprint':'static.prop.streetbarrier',
              'xyz_m':[x,y,.2]} for i,(x,y) in enumerate(
                  ((40,-3.4),(40,-.1),(60,-3.4),(60,-.1)))]
    put(output/'native-map-readback.json',{
        'source_kind':'synthetic_cpu','road_sha256':sha(bundle/'alley-zone.xodr'),
        'native_map_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'synthetic-c10374-road374').hexdigest(),
        'lane_readback':{f'{x}:{lane}':{'road_id':374,'lane_id':lane,
            'lane_type':'sidewalk' if x==50 and lane==-1 else 'driving'}
            for x in (20,50,80) for lane in (-1,-2)},
        'ego_actor_id':101,'generated_alley_lanes_verified':True,
        'native_zone_delimiters':markers,'zone_rectangle_xy_m':cfg['zone_rectangle_xy_m'],
        'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,'legal_verdict':None})
    actors=[];videos=[];reviews=[]
    for i,request in enumerate(requests):
        x,y=request['requested_ego_x_m'],request['requested_ego_y_m']
        previous=requests[i-1]['requested_ego_x_m'] if i else x
        speed=round((x-previous)*20,6)
        native=i+1000;t=request['time_s']
        actors.append({'frame':i,'native_frame':native,'time_s':t,
            'source_kind':'synthetic_cpu','requested_ego_x_m':x,'requested_ego_y_m':y,
            'ego':vehicle(x,y,speed), 'observed_road_id':374,
            'observed_lane_id':request['requested_lane_id'],
            'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,
            'actual_zone_overlap_observed':False,'legal_verdict':None})
        videos.append({'video_frame':i,'native_frame':native,'time_s':t})
        reviews.append({'frame':i,'native_frame':native,'time_s':t,
            'source_kind':'synthetic_cpu','review_provenance':'synthetic_cpu',
            'forward_video_sha256':'synthetic_cpu','overview_video_sha256':'synthetic_cpu',
            'reference_corner_video_sha256':'synthetic_cpu',
            'driver_reference_video_sha256':'synthetic_cpu',
            'zone_boundary_pixel_reviewed':False,
            'zone_boundary_visible':None})
    put_rows(output/'native-raw-actors.jsonl',actors)
    put_rows(output/'video_frames.jsonl',videos)
    put_rows(output/'frame-review.jsonl',reviews)
    put(output/'native-capture-report.json',{
        'case_id':cfg['case_id'],'candidate_id':cfg['candidate_id'],
        'config_sha256':sha(bundle/'config.json'),
        'requested_frames':600,'observed_frames':600,
        'restoration':{'synthetic_cpu':True},'error':None,'accepted':False,
        'generated_alley_lanes_verified':True,
        'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,
        'legal_verdict':None,'delivery_ready':False})
    return {'source_kind':'synthetic_cpu','frames':600}


if __name__=='__main__':

    p.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path,required=True)

"""Source-only zone primary diagnostic finalizer; no designation or legal verdict."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError('Missing required source: ' + path.name)
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def measure_zone_overlap(attempt):
    root = Path(attempt)
    actors = rows(root / 'native-raw-actors.jsonl')
    map_path = root / 'native-map-readback.json'
    if not map_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError('Missing required source: native-map-readback.json')
    mapping = json.loads(map_path.read_text())
    if len(actors) != 600 or len(mapping.get('native_zone_delimiters', [])) != 4:
        raise ValueError('Zone actor or delimiter source incomplete')
    bounds = mapping['zone_rectangle_xy_m']
    count = 0
    for index, row in enumerate(actors):
        ego = row['ego']
        body = ego['body_native_xyz_m']
        xs = [point[0] for point in body]
        ys = [point[1] for point in body]
        if row['frame'] != index or len(body) != 8:
            raise ValueError('Original body/frame join changed')
        if max(xs) >= bounds[0] and min(xs) <= bounds[1] and max(ys) >= bounds[2] and min(ys) <= bounds[3] and ego['speed_mps'] > 0.1:
            count += 1
    return {'value': count, 'method': 'measure_zone_overlap',
            'sources': {'native-raw-actors.jsonl': sha(root / 'native-raw-actors.jsonl'),
                        'native-map-readback.json': sha(map_path)},
            'scope': 'body versus authored rectangle; official designation unverified'}


def measure_zone_setup(attempt):
    path = Path(attempt) / 'native-map-readback.json'
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError('Missing required source: native-map-readback.json')
    mapping = json.loads(path.read_text())
    delimiters = mapping.get('native_zone_delimiters', [])
    if len(delimiters) != 4:
        raise ValueError('Zone delimiter source incomplete')
    return {'value': {'delimiter_count': len(delimiters),
                      'native_map_sha256': mapping['native_map_sha256'],
                      'official_designation_verified': False},
            'method': 'measure_zone_setup',
            'sources': {'native-map-readback.json': sha(path)},
            'scope': 'authored map and Native marker readback; designation requires independent review'}


def finalize(attempt, output):
    root = Path(attempt)
    config = json.loads((root / 'config.json').read_text())
    measurement = measure_zone_overlap(root)
    setup_measurement = measure_zone_setup(root)
    actors = rows(root / 'native-raw-actors.jsonl')
    frames = rows(root / 'video_frames.jsonl')
    trace = rows(root / 'trace.jsonl')
    evidence = rows(root / 'capture/evidence.jsonl')
    if any(len(source) != 600 for source in (actors, frames, trace, evidence)):
        raise ValueError('Original source counts differ')
    for actor, frame, motion, source in zip(actors, frames, trace, evidence):
        native = actor['native_frame']
        if any(value != native for value in (frame['native_frame'], frame['carla_frame'], motion['frame'], source['original_frame'])):
            raise ValueError('Original Native frame join differs')
        if any(abs(value - actor['time_s']) > 1e-6 for value in (frame['time_s'], motion['time_s'], source['recording_time_s'])):
            raise ValueError('Original Native time join differs')
    channels = root / 'channels'
    if channels.exists():
        raise ValueError('Fixture supplied derived channels')
    channels.mkdir()
    for name, value in (
        ('kin.speed', lambda row: row['ego']['speed_mps']),
        ('zone_body', lambda row: row['ego']['body_native_xyz_m']),
    ):
        (channels / (name + '.jsonl')).write_text(''.join(
            json.dumps({'time_s': row['time_s'], 'value': value(row)}) + '\n' for row in actors))
    planned = config['recording_description']
    evidence_rows = [{'name': channel['name'], 'unit': channel['unit'],
                      'reference': 'channels/' + channel['name'] + '.jsonl'}
                     for channel in planned['channels']]
    observed = measurement['value']
    requested = 1 if config['requested_zone_route'] else 0
    measured = int(observed > 0)
    mapping = json.loads((root / 'native-map-readback.json').read_text())
    original = (mapping.get('source_kind') == 'original_native' and
                all(row.get('source_kind') == 'original_native' for row in actors))
    centers = [row['ego']['center_native_xyz_m'] for row in actors]
    progress = abs(centers[-1][0] - centers[0][0])
    moving = sum(row['ego']['speed_mps'] > .1 for row in actors)
    route_complete = original and progress >= 15 and moving >= 20
    observed_motion = {'route_progress_m': progress, 'moving_samples': moving,
                       'moving_body_rectangle_overlap_frames': observed}
    physical_checks = {
        'maneuver': {'status': 'met' if route_complete else ('not_met' if original else 'unverified'),
                     'method': '600 joined original-frame body and speed samples, route progress and motion',
                     'sources': {'native-raw-actors.jsonl': sha(root / 'native-raw-actors.jsonl'),
                                 'video_frames.jsonl': sha(root / 'video_frames.jsonl')},
                     'details': {'route_progress_m': progress, 'moving_samples': moving,
                                 'engineering_progress_threshold_m': 15}},
        'setup': {'status': 'unverified',
                  'method': 'native map and delimiter readback; official designation needs source review',
                  'sources': {'native-map-readback.json': sha(root / 'native-map-readback.json')},
                  'details': {'native_delimiters': len(mapping['native_zone_delimiters']),
                              'official_safety_zone_designation_verified': False}},
    }
    fixed = {'cell_id': config['cell_id'], 'law_id': config['law_id'], 'actor': config['actor'],
             'map_sha256': mapping['native_map_sha256'],
             'camera_contract_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(config['cameras'], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
             'duration_s': config['duration_s'], 'rate_hz': config['rate_hz'],
             'weather_profile': 'ClearNoon'}
    result = {
        'case_id': config['case_id'],
        'measured_values': {'moving_body_rectangle_overlap_frames': observed},
        'target_checks': [{'target': 'moving vehicle body overlaps authored zone rectangle',
                           'requested': requested, 'measured': measured,
                           'method': 'source-hashed complete body polygon at 20 Hz',
                           'tolerance': 0, 'matched': requested == measured,
                           'physical_cause_confirmed': False,
                           'cause_evidence': ['native-raw-actors.jsonl', 'native-map-readback.json']}],
        'setup_confirmed': False, 'behavior_attempted': original,
        'maneuver_completed': route_complete,
        'termination_reason': ('original full-duration source processed' if original else
                               'synthetic full-duration source fixture processed'),
        'physical_failure_flags': ['official_safety_zone_designation_unverified',
                                   'original_native_motion_and_pixels_unverified'],
        'trace_reference': 'trace.jsonl',
        'video_references': ['overview.mkv', 'approach.mkv', 'reference_corner.mkv', 'driver_reference.mkv'],
        'video_frame_map_reference': 'video_frames.jsonl',
        'recording_description': planned, 'recording_evidence': evidence_rows,
        'realized_observables': observed_motion if original else {},
        'physical_checks': physical_checks, 'comparison_fixed_conditions': fixed,
        'official_safety_zone_designation_verified': False,
        'provenance_kind': 'original_native' if original else 'synthetic_fixture',
        'diagnostic_fixture': not original,
        'accepted': False, 'legal_verdict_claimed': False,
    }
    (root / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    report = {'format': 'c10374-zone-current-v2-analysis', 'case_id': config['case_id'],
              'measurements': {'zone_overlap_frames': measurement, 'zone_setup_readback': setup_measurement},
              'source_only': True, 'official_safety_zone_designation_verified': False,
              'legal_outcome_claimed': False}
    Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--attempt', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
